info.title: Spctre API
info.description: The Spctre public REST API. All endpoints are versioned under `/api/v1/` and follow the same envelope convention: every response carries a `meta` object with a `traceId`, `version`, and `ts` timestamp. Authenticate with a service account API key issued from the Spctre web UI (`spctre init` or Settings → API Keys).

bearerAuth.description: Service account API key. Generate one from the Spctre web UI under Settings → API Keys, then pass it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys carry declared permission scopes such as `decision:evaluate`, `evidence:write`, `bundle:read`, `policy:import`, `compliance:read`, `approvals:read`, `operations:read`, `workflow:read`, `members:read`, and `workspaces:read` that are enforced at the API layer. `policy:import` is admin-issuable only and is never granted to runtime agent tokens, so a governed agent cannot import its own policy.

sessionCookie.name: spctre_session_id
sessionCookie.description: Browser session established by signing in to the control plane. Used only by operations that represent a human decision and therefore cannot be delegated to a service account; every other endpoint takes a bearer key.

gatewayWebhookSecret.name: x-spctre-gateway-secret
gatewayWebhookSecret.description: Gateway webhook secret. Per-provider signature headers are also accepted; see the endpoint description.

traceId.description: Correlation ID echoed from X-Request-ID or generated server-side.

TriggerKind.description: The invocation origin of the agent tool call.

EvidenceLayer.description: Whether the evidence record originates from the agent layer (L7 tool calls) or sandbox layer (L3/L4 network policy).

sandboxName.description: Runtime sandbox/deployment name for sandbox-layer policy and evidence queries.

inferenceProvider.description: Inference router/provider identifier for model-routing policy and evidence queries.

decisionId.description: Unique ID for this governance decision (idempotency key).

tenantId.description: Optional tenant boundary hint. Empty string is treated as omitted. The x-spctre-tenant-id header takes precedence when both are present; otherwise inferred from the bearer token when omitted.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace boundary hint. Empty string is treated as omitted. The x-spctre-workspace-id header takes precedence when both are present; otherwise inferred from the bearer token when omitted.

policyRefs.description: Required when ingestMode is omitted or 'standard'. Omit only when ingestMode is 'gateway'.

artifactHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the policy bundle artifact. Required in standard mode.

policyContext.description: Required in standard mode; server resolves it in gateway mode.

createdAt.description: Decision timestamp. Defaults to server time when omitted.

rawEvidence.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the evidence record.

ingestMode.description: Use 'gateway' when posting from a gateway adapter; the server resolves policyRefs, artifactHash, and policyContext automatically.

toolIntent.description: The explicitly declared intent or purpose of the tool call.

planSummary.description: A high-level plan summary explicitly provided by the runtime.

toolParameters.description: The structured arguments passed to the tool.

executionContext.description: Execution surface identity plus sandbox/inference-router evidence references.

parentAgentId.description: Agent ID of the parent when this evidence originates from a subagent.

traceId.description: Distributed trace identifier linking related agent decisions across subagents.

orchestratorRef.description: Orchestrator-platform reference (e.g. Paperclip companyId, issueId, goalId).

skillContext.description: Prompt-level governance surface: active skills, instruction files, and prompt policy refs present when the decision was made.

webhookSource.description: Source identifier for inbound webhook triggers (present when triggerKind is inbound_webhook).

trustLevel.description: Trust level assigned by the orchestration platform (e.g. Paperclip trust preset).

catalogProvider.description: Catalog or skill provenance provider (e.g. Paperclip catalog-provenance identifier).

gateway.description: Gateway evaluation result, if the gateway is enabled.

deduplicated.description: True when a record with the same decisionId already exists (200 response).

contentHash.description: SHA-256 identity of the exact retained bytes.

retained.description: True when the byte-exact artifact is durably retained (including idempotent repeats).

GitCheckpointIngestRequest.description: Framework-agnostic Git checkpoint and diff evidence. Clients submit normalized Git facts; the server does not execute Git or access a caller repository.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable checkpoint submission key. Reuse it to safely retry.

connector.description: Optional client connector label; defaults to git.

action.description: Optional action label; defaults to checkpoint.ingest.

policyRefs.description: Caller-supplied references retained as metadata. Policy context is resolved server-side.

PublicationAttestationIngestRequest.description: Framework-agnostic publication facts. Clients submit normalized facts bound to a previously retained byte-exact artifact; the server never fetches a URL, renders a page, or adjudicates compliance.

tenantId.description: Optional tenant boundary hint. Empty string is treated as omitted. The x-spctre-tenant-id header takes precedence when both are present; otherwise inferred from the bearer token when omitted.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace boundary hint. Empty string is treated as omitted. The x-spctre-workspace-id header takes precedence when both are present; otherwise inferred from the bearer token when omitted.

toolIntent.description: The explicitly declared intent or purpose of the tool call.

planSummary.description: A high-level plan summary explicitly provided by the runtime.

toolParameters.description: The structured arguments passed to the tool.

agentId.description: Runtime agent identity used to link this decision to cross-surface evidence and governance history.

sessionId.description: Stable runtime session identifier used for Blueprint loop safeguards.

GatewayWebhookRequest.description: Raw provider webhook payload from Portkey, Helicone, or LiteLLM. Spctre normalizes provider-specific fields into runtime evidence.

provenanceGap.description: True when Spctre could not fully link the gateway event to a published policy revision or connector mapping.

deduplicated.description: True when the provider event was already ingested.

EscalationQueueItem.description: An open escalation queue item awaiting human review.

approvedToolParameters.description: Confirmation of the decision arguments a human reviewed — not an execution source. Sensitive keys are redacted and depth/size are bounded when the decision is recorded, so this is a lossy snapshot: execute from your own parameters and use this to confirm they match what was approved. Present only when the escalation is RESOLVED with a PROCEED outcome.

BundleResponse.description: The latest published policy bundle for the workspace. Response headers carry `x-spctre-branch-id`, `x-spctre-revision-id`, `x-spctre-artifact-hash`, and `x-spctre-published-at`.

artifact.description: Target artifact. String for text formats, object for JSON/bundle formats.

domains.description: Optional domain tags used for additional policy matching.

toolIntent.description: The explicitly declared intent or purpose of the tool call.

planSummary.description: A high-level plan summary explicitly provided by the runtime.

toolParameters.description: The structured arguments passed to the tool.

result.description: Policy evaluation result from the published bundle.

verifierDigest.description: Immutable verifier build or configuration digest.

source.description: The raw AGT-compatible policy document (YAML or JSON).

branchName.description: Target branch name. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and slashes; cannot start or end with a hyphen or slash.

scope.description: Branch scope. Optional; the server defaults to WORKSPACE when omitted.

connector.description: Connector id. Required when scope is CONNECTOR.

environment.description: Environment. Required when scope is ENVIRONMENT.

sourcePath.description: Provenance path recorded with the revision.

targetStacks.description: Optional AGT-compatible export target stacks recorded with the revision.

created.description: True when a brand-new branch was created (HTTP 201).

alreadyCurrent.description: True when the branch head already carried this exact source; no write was performed.

source.description: The raw declarative Blueprint source document (YAML or JSON): an envelope of name, agentId, message, and definition. The definition names its governing policy branch via policyBranchId (a branch name) and must not pin policyRevisionId.

sourcePath.description: Provenance path recorded with the revision.

definitionHash.description: SHA-256 of the bound Blueprint definition.

created.description: True when a brand-new Blueprint was created (HTTP 201).

alreadyCurrent.description: True when a revision with this exact bound definition already existed; no write was performed.

policyBranchId.description: Resolved id of the governing policy branch.

policyRevisionId.description: Resolved id of the branch's published revision the Blueprint is bound to.

approval.description: The approval record for the requested revision.

Forbidden.description: Token lacks the required scope for this operation.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

CloudOnly.description: This endpoint requires the Spctre Cloud plan. OSS tenants receive this structured error rather than a 404.

post.description: Records an agent runtime governance decision in the evidence store. Supports both standard mode (caller supplies policyRefs, artifactHash, policyContext) and gateway mode (server resolves policy context via revision-at-time lookup). Duplicate `decisionId` submissions return 200 with `deduplicated: true` and are suppressed.

get.summary: Download the latest published policy bundle
get.description: Returns the latest published policy bundle for the authenticated workspace. Without `format`, the response is the raw AGT-compatible JSON bundle. `x-spctre-policy-content-hash` is SHA-256 over those exact JSON bytes, distinct from the semantic artifact hash. With `format`, the response is an export envelope containing a target artifact and manifest. Use `preview=true` with no format to inspect all target manifests without downloading artifacts.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional target export format. Omit for the raw AGT-compatible bundle.

parameters.name: preview
parameters.description: When true and format is omitted, returns manifests for all supported export targets without artifacts.

200.description: Latest published bundle, export envelope, or preview manifest list.

409.description: Requested export target is blocked because semantics cannot be safely preserved.

500.description: Export artifact failed local manifest verification before handoff.

post.summary: Retain exact bytes of the latest published policy bundle
post.description: Materializes the exact raw bundle bytes under their SHA-256 content hash and links them atomically to the immutable policy publication event. This is distinct from the semantic artifact hash and is safe to call repeatedly.

201.description: Published bundle bytes retained and linked to their publication.

get.description: Generates and returns the latest compliance packet for the workspace as a JSON attachment. Optionally annotated for a specific framework (`soc2`, `iso27001`, `hipaa`, `gdpr`, `pci-dss`, `nist-ai-rmf`, `public-sector`, `eu-ai-act`).

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Framework to annotate the export for. When omitted the raw packet is returned without framework-specific annotations.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Export format. PDF export is plan-gated.

post.description: Evaluates a connector + action pair against the latest published policy bundle without persisting a record. Useful for CI/CD checks and policy simulation.

Imports a local AGT-compatible policy document into the control plane as an unapproved draft branch/revision, for automation/CI. Requires the `policy:import` scope, which is admin-issuable only and never granted to runtime agent tokens. Idempotent on the branch identity `(workspace, scope, environment, connector, branchName)` and the source hash: a new branch returns 201; an unchanged re-import returns 200 with `alreadyCurrent: true` and writes nothing; changed source appends a new draft revision. Never approves or publishes — review and publication remain manual.

200.description: Existing branch updated, or already current (no write).

post.summary: Import a local agent Blueprint source (idempotent)
post.description: Imports a declarative agent Blueprint source into the control plane as an unapproved DRAFT, for automation/CI. Requires the `blueprint:import` scope, which is admin-issuable only and never granted to runtime agent tokens — so a governed agent can never define its own authority. The source names its governing policy branch (`definition.policyBranchId`, a branch name) and must not pin a revision; the import resolves that branch's currently-published revision and fails closed (409) if none. Idempotent on `(workspace, agentId)` and the bound definition hash: a new Blueprint returns 201; a re-import of an unchanged, same-bound definition returns 200 with `alreadyCurrent: true` and writes nothing; a changed definition appends a new draft revision. Never approves or publishes.

200.description: Revision appended, or already current (no write).

409.description: The named policy branch has no published revision; publish the policy first.
